_comment: Per-string context pushed to Crowdin by `npm run i18n:context`. One line per key saying where the string appears and what constrains it — the facts a translator cannot get from the English alone. Written when the string is, by whoever ran /wording. Keys mirror en.json.
no_threats.1: Shown alone when no enemy is engaged, so it has to stand by itself. Keys 1-12 are the only ones drawn before the investigator has faced a threat, so they stay lighter in tone than 13-25; match the length and rhythm of the rest of that first dozen.
no_threats.2: Opening no-threats line (1-12 pool). Stands alone; keep it light, and match the pool's rhythm.
